study_type: retrospective pre-tournament-information backtest; not contemporaneous predictions

tuning.protocol: Frozen training-end ratings; no validation updates. Choose minimum validation log loss separately for each model; ties choose first candidate.

elo.protocol: Frozen 2021-end ratings; chronological scoring, not model updates or epochs.

poisson.protocol: Frozen 2021-end ratings; chronological scoring, not model updates or epochs.

uncertainty.calibration: 95% Wilson binomial intervals, unadjusted for repeated-team/group dependence; descriptive only.
uncertainty.bootstrap: 4000 paired resamples, NumPy default_rng seed 2026, linear percentile 95% intervals; model minus reference log loss.
uncertainty.cluster: Sample G group IDs with replacement; retain all matches per sampled group; ratio of sums/counts. Only 12 groups; not team/network robust.
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on fitted models. No refitting or parameter-selection uncertainty. Not betting edge or profit.

limitations: Retrospective analysis; no claim forecasts were generated before the event.
Current historical snapshot filtered by match date, not an archived point-in-time database.
Historical goals can include extra time; evaluation is group-stage regulation time only.
Single tournament and repeated teams; bootstrap intervals may understate uncertainty.
No bookmaker odds obtained; no market outperformance or betting profitability established.
Calibration bins are descriptive; no calibration fitting on held-out tournament outcomes.
Uniform argmax ties choose home; its accuracy is an arbitrary tie-break, not random-guess expected accuracy.
